name: unique2
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_unique2(Tensor self, bool sorted=True, bool return_inverse=False, bool return_counts=False) -> (Tensor, Tensor, Tensor). Returns unique values plus optional inverse indices and counts without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover sorted flags, every inverse/count flag combination, small and large implementation paths, empty/all-same/all-unique inputs, float and integer dtypes, NaN/Inf/signed-zero behavior, output metadata, reconstruction, and input non-mutation.
